description: With a deal_id: that deal's plain log, which the buyer and the seller both read. Without: the person's deals and listings, which deals wait for the person, and questions: the ones buyers asked on the person's listings (waiting_for_you) and the ones the person asked (asked). A seller's agent hears of agreed and bound deals with market_wait, and calls this now and then for buyers' questions to answer, which a wait does not tell. When a deal waits on the seller's person well after the buyer's person approved, the buyer's answer has seller_idle with the wait and, when one fits, another listing. Once a deal is bound (both people approved), it shows the other side's email in contact and in the log: give it to the person.

deal_id.description: A deal_id from market_make_offer or market_deal_log.

owner_key.description: The owner_key from the person's first market_make_offer or market_create_listing (or from market_sign_in). Keep it private to this conversation.

name: market_deal_log

next_action.description: What to do next, as a code: the same advice as next_step.

next_step.description: What to do next, in one or two sentences.

wait_cursor.description: Without deal_id: send as since to market_wait.

title: Read the deal log
